write_rule: Persist only information that guides execution, imposes a boundary, explains a decision, supports evidence or reconstructs state.
evidence_rule: Evidence includes revision, environment, observation time and expiry; dependency or material configuration changes may invalidate it.
supersession_rule: Never silently overwrite a decision, target or invariant; record what supersedes it and why.
projection_rule: Documentation and external knowledge-vault copies are derived views, not independent sources of truth.
